content:
Alex: Heads-up — I found a KMS-wrapped blob pasted in a staging log dump on a partner channel. Looks like a Vault-wrapped token leaked during a helm upgrade. Need immediate rotation and containment.
Maria: Can you share the link privately? If it's wrapped we still need to rewrap and revoke, but scope may be limited.
Alex: DM'd the snippet to @Maria and @Chris. Minimal excerpt (sanitized):
```
sops/encrypted: |
  GCP-KMS:CiRAbX... (truncated)
```
Do NOT paste the blob elsewhere.
sec-oncall-bot: Incident created INC-2024-0912. Assigned: @Chris, @Maria. Initial severity: medium. Containment checklist started.
Chris: On it. Immediate plan: 1) revoke any active Vault tokens that match the pattern 2) rewrap KMS wrapping key 3) rotate CI SA keys if there are unwrapped exports. Commands I'll run (streaming, no full download):
```
vault token revoke -prefix staging-ci-
# rewrap (pseudo): gcloud kms encrypt --key=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/helm-keys/cryptoKeys/wrapKey --plaintext-file=- --ciphertext-file=-
# rotate SA key: gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete KEY_ID --iam-account=ci@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```
Maria: I'll run a quick repo/CI log search for similar patterns: `rg "GCP-KMS:" && grep -R "wrapped_blob" /var/log/ci-artefacts` and add a lifecycle filter on our GCS audit logs.
Alex: Found the artifact path: gs://redwood-staging-artifacts/helm-upgrade-2024-09-12/log.txt. Granting Chris temporary read (storage.objects.get) while we triage. Also changed the staging-bucket IAM: granted storage.objects.get to chris@redwood.com for 1 hour.
Chris: Streaming grep against the object, not downloading. Revoked 3 tokens matching staging-ci- prefix. Creating a short-lived deny for the CI SA now.
KMS-Bot: Automated note: rewrap job created for projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/helm-keys by Maria. Job id: rewrap-20240912-1.
Maria: Added an audit query: filter protoPayload.resourceName:projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/helm-keys AND protoPayload.methodName:("Encrypt" OR "Decrypt") over the last 30d. Tagging @sec-audit for log pull and timeline.
Chris: Can we temporarily tighten RBAC on the CI service account (remove key create/export) until we finish? Draft IAM change here: `roles/iam.serviceAccountKeyAdmin` -> remove from ci@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com. @Alex approve?
Alex: Approved. Also we should rotate helm values/sealed-secrets for staging and redeploy. Owner: Sam. ETA: 2 hours. :thumbsup:
Sam: Picking this up now — regenerating sealed-secrets and Helm value blobs, will trigger a rolling restart of staging workloads after deploy. Will update INC-2024-0912 when done.
sec-oncall-bot: INC-2024-0912 status: containment in place, rotation in progress, postmortem required. Action items: (1) confirm no prod tokens leaked, (2) collect timeline and commit that introduced logging, (3) recommend CI secrets handling policy (no plaintext/wrapped logs).
Alex: Good catches everyone. After we close containment we should push an RBAC hardening PR and add a pre-commit log-scrub check for the CI pipeline.
Maria: I'll draft the post-incident runbook steps and share in #eng-security-docs.
Chris: Logging the commands I ran and outputs to the incident ticket (no blob contents). Closing loop once Sam confirms redeploy succeeded.
